title: Wasay Laboratories — Rediscover the Power of Natural Healing
description: Wasay Laboratories (Pvt.) Ltd. is one of the largest natural products manufacturers in Pakistan, offering medicines, supplements, foods and beverages.

hero.heading: Rediscover the Power of Natural Healing
hero.lead: One of the largest natural products manufacturers in Pakistan, bringing together the best of nature and the best of science.

ranges.heading: Every range, rooted in nature.
ranges.text: Tablets, multi tonics, syrups, ointments and pastes, all made by Wasay Laboratories. Open a range to meet each product, turn it in 3D and read what it is for.

ring.heading: Take a closer look.
ring.label: Wasay products. Drag, scroll or use the left and right arrow keys to turn the ring, and press Enter or click to open a product.
